label: locationReadsTheSelectedStopInPercent: the row reads the raw offset, so a stop at 50% shows 0.5
find: static func percent(_ offset: Double) -> Double { min(max(offset, 0), 1) * 100 }
replace: static func percent(_ offset: Double) -> Double { min(max(offset, 0), 1) }

typeSwitchIsSharedAndNamesItsNote: the off switch's note loses its prefix, so apps can't find it
find: public nonisolated static func helpID(in prefix: String) -> String { "\(prefix).help" }
replace: public nonisolated static func helpID(in prefix: String) -> String { "help" }
